script: The NBA is officially back today, October 20th, kicking off the season with three games on opening night. First, at 3:00 PM Eastern, we have the Celtics versus Pistons. Detroit actually won 60 games last season, finishing first in the Eastern Conference. So can Cade and the Pistons prove that this wasn't a one-year fluke against Jason Tatum, who needs to prove that Boston can lead without Jaylen Brown? Then at 7:00 PM Eastern, things get interesting. The Knicks are raising their first championship banner since 1973, and they're opening up against LeBron James and the 76ers. Both players will make their regular season Philly debut alongside Joel Embiid, and the same Sixers team that swept Philadelphia in last year's playoffs. And finally, at 9:30 PM Eastern, we have Wemby and the Spurs hosting Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder. This is basically a rematch of last year's Western Conference finals, where San Antonio eliminated OKC in seven games before eventually losing to the New York Knicks in the finals. All three games have reason to pay attention to them. Which one are you looking forward to the most?
